title: Show that there is some B so that no integer appears more than B times among the binomial coefficients
exact_target: Is there a uniform bound on the number of occurrences in Pascal’s triangle of any integer greater than one?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3100064 (AMR-030-0064). CC BY 4.0.
